about: The new alts for the four served photos the page's frame (reviews, newsletter, enquiry form) shows again after a body slot already used them. The frame sections plan no image slot and no assets[] row, so these alts have no home in the board record; Task 44 (the page build) reads each one from here by section and passes it as the component's photoAlt. Working rule 11 (user, 2026-09-29): a photo keeps its served alt on its first use and each repeat carries a new alt, never a copy. Each alt was written from the picture and approved by the breeder.
